args.question: You asked me to pay Cobalt Labs's approved invoice, but Cobalt Labs (V-222) has two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-34905 for $5,983.10 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-36824 for $1,652.34 (due 2026-11-25). trace.message: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Cobalt Labs invoice INV-36824 in full by wire, and it went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-36824 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $1,652.34
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent and confirmed by the system

Cobalt Labs had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay. You chose this one and said the other, INV-34905 ($5,983.10), is under dispute, so I left it unpaid. There were no earlier payments from the operating account, so this isn't a duplicate. I also attached a one-time key to the wire so a retry can't send it twice. Controller approval wasn't needed because the payment is under $10,000.
